hero.subtitle: Vumbura inzu z'akataraboneka mu bice byiza cyane mu gihugu.

home.cta_subtitle: Sanga abantu barenga 10,000 bamaze kubona inzu z'inzozi zabo binyuze kuri HomeVista.

about.story_p: Yatangiye mu 2026, HomeVista yabaye inkingi ya mwamba mu bucuruzi bw'inzu z'agaciro. Duza abaguzi bafite amahitamo adasanzwe n'inzu z'akataraboneka zishushanyije mu buryo bugezweho.
